21:1.text: Draws near for mankind their reckoning, while they turn away in heedlessness.

21:2.text: Comes not unto them an admonition
from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play

21:3.text: . Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels,
more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?"

21:4.text: in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower."

21:5.text: (revelations of the Qur’ân which are revealed to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented them! - Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayâh

21:6.text: , of those which We destroyed, believed before them

21:7.text: And We sent not before you
but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder

21:8.text: And We did not create them
bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals.

21:9.text: Then We fulfilled to them the promise. So We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifûn
(i.e. disbelievers in Allah, in His Messengers, extravagants, transgressors of Allâh’s limits by committing crimes, oppressions, polytheism and sins)

21:10.text: Indeed, We have sent down for you
(your Reminder or an honour for you i.e. honour for the one who follows the teaching of the Qur’ân and acts on its teachings)
